name: workspaces
description: Amazon WorkSpaces Service Amazon WorkSpaces enables you to provision virtual, cloud-based Microsoft Windows or Amazon Linux desktops for your users, known as WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: accept-account-link-invitation
subcommands.description: Accepts the account link invitation.

subcommands.name: associate-connection-alias
subcommands.description: Associates the specified connection alias with the specified directory to enable cross-Region redirection.

subcommands.name: associate-ip-groups
subcommands.description: Associates the specified IP access control group with the specified directory.

subcommands.name: associate-workspace-application
subcommands.description: Associates the specified application to the specified WorkSpace.

subcommands.name: authorize-ip-rules
subcommands.description: Adds one or more rules to the specified IP access control group.

subcommands.name: copy-workspace-image
subcommands.description: Copies the specified image from the specified Region to the current Region.

subcommands.name: create-account-link-invitation
subcommands.description: Creates the account link invitation.

subcommands.name: create-connect-client-add-in
subcommands.description: Creates a client-add-in for Connect Customer within a directory.

subcommands.name: create-connection-alias
subcommands.description: Creates the specified connection alias for use with cross-Region redirection.

subcommands.name: create-ip-group
subcommands.description: Creates an IP access control group.

subcommands.name: create-standby-workspaces
subcommands.description: Creates a standby WorkSpace in a secondary Region.

subcommands.name: create-tags
subcommands.description: Creates the specified tags for the specified WorkSpaces resource.

subcommands.name: create-updated-workspace-image
subcommands.description: Creates a new updated WorkSpace image based on the specified source image.

subcommands.name: create-workspace-bundle
subcommands.description: Creates the specified WorkSpace bundle.

subcommands.name: create-workspace-image
subcommands.description: Creates a new WorkSpace image from an existing WorkSpace.

subcommands.name: create-workspaces
subcommands.description: Creates one or more WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: create-workspaces-pool
subcommands.description: Creates a pool of WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: delete-account-link-invitation
subcommands.description: Deletes the account link invitation.

subcommands.name: delete-client-branding
subcommands.description: Deletes customized client branding.

subcommands.name: delete-connect-client-add-in
subcommands.description: Deletes a client-add-in for Connect Customer that is configured within a directory.

subcommands.name: delete-connection-alias
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified connection alias.

subcommands.name: delete-ip-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified IP access control group.

subcommands.name: delete-tags
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified tags from the specified WorkSpaces resource.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace-bundle
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified WorkSpace bundle.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace-image
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified image from your account.

subcommands.name: deploy-workspace-applications
subcommands.description: Deploys associated applications to the specified WorkSpace

subcommands.name: deregister-workspace-directory
subcommands.description: Deregisters the specified directory.

subcommands.name: describe-account
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list that describes the configuration of Bring Your Own License (BYOL) for the specified account.

subcommands.name: describe-account-modifications
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list that describes modifications to the configuration of Bring Your Own License (BYOL) for the specified account.

subcommands.name: describe-application-associations
subcommands.description: Describes the associations between the application and the specified associated resources.

subcommands.name: describe-applications
subcommands.description: Describes the specified applications by filtering based on their compute types, license availability, operating systems, and owners.

subcommands.name: describe-bundle-associations
subcommands.description: Describes the associations between the applications and the specified bundle.

subcommands.name: describe-client-branding
subcommands.description: Describes the specified client branding.

subcommands.name: describe-client-properties
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list that describes one or more specified Amazon WorkSpaces clients.

subcommands.name: describe-connect-client-add-ins
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of Connect Customer client add-ins that have been created.

subcommands.name: describe-connection-alias-permissions
subcommands.description: Describes the permissions that the owner of a connection alias has granted to another Amazon Web Services account for the specified connection alias.

subcommands.name: describe-connection-aliases
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list that describes the connection aliases used for cross-Region redirection.

subcommands.name: describe-custom-workspace-image-import
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a WorkSpace BYOL image being imported via ImportCustomWorkspaceImage.

subcommands.name: describe-image-associations
subcommands.description: Describes the associations between the applications and the specified image.

subcommands.name: describe-ip-groups
subcommands.description: Describes one or more of your IP access control groups.

subcommands.name: describe-tags
subcommands.description: Describes the specified tags for the specified WorkSpaces resource.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-associations
subcommands.description: Describes the associations betweens applications and the specified WorkSpace.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-bundles
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list that describes the available WorkSpace bundles.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-directories
subcommands.description: Describes the available directories that are registered with Amazon WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-image-permissions
subcommands.description: Describes the permissions that the owner of an image has granted to other Amazon Web Services accounts for an image.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-images
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list that describes one or more specified images, if the image identifiers are provided.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-snapshots
subcommands.description: Describes the snapshots for the specified WorkSpace.

subcommands.name: describe-workspaces
subcommands.description: Describes the specified WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: describe-workspaces-connection-status
subcommands.description: Describes the connection status of the specified WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: describe-workspaces-pool-sessions
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list that describes the streaming sessions for a specified pool.

subcommands.name: describe-workspaces-pools
subcommands.description: Describes the specified WorkSpaces Pools.

subcommands.name: disassociate-connection-alias
subcommands.description: Disassociates a connection alias from a directory.

subcommands.name: disassociate-ip-groups
subcommands.description: Disassociates the specified IP access control group from the specified directory.

subcommands.name: disassociate-workspace-application
subcommands.description: Disassociates the specified application from a WorkSpace.

subcommands.name: get-account-link
subcommands.description: Retrieves account link information.

subcommands.name: import-client-branding
subcommands.description: Imports client branding.

subcommands.name: import-custom-workspace-image
subcommands.description: Imports the specified Windows 10 or 11 Bring Your Own License (BYOL) image into Amazon WorkSpaces using EC2 Image Builder.

subcommands.name: import-workspace-image
subcommands.description: Imports the specified Windows 10 or 11 Bring Your Own License (BYOL) image into Amazon WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: list-account-links
subcommands.description: Lists all account links.

subcommands.name: list-available-management-cidr-ranges
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of IP address ranges, specified as IPv4 CIDR blocks, that you can use for the network management interface when you enable Bring Your Own License (BYOL).

subcommands.name: migrate-workspace
subcommands.description: Migrates a WorkSpace from one operating system or bundle type to another, while retaining the data on the user volume.

subcommands.name: modify-account
subcommands.description: Modifies the configuration of Bring Your Own License (BYOL) for the specified account.

subcommands.name: modify-certificate-based-auth-properties
subcommands.description: Modifies the properties of the certificate-based authentication you want to use with your WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: modify-client-properties
subcommands.description: Modifies the properties of the specified Amazon WorkSpaces clients.

subcommands.name: modify-endpoint-encryption-mode
subcommands.description: Modifies the endpoint encryption mode that allows you to configure the specified directory between Standard TLS and FIPS 140-2 validated mode.

subcommands.name: modify-saml-properties
subcommands.description: Modifies multiple properties related to SAML 2.0 authentication, including the enablement status, user access URL, and relay state parameter name that are used for configuring federation with an SAML 2.0 identity provider.

subcommands.name: modify-selfservice-permissions
subcommands.description: Modifies the self-service WorkSpace management capabilities for your users.

subcommands.name: modify-streaming-properties
subcommands.description: Modifies the specified streaming properties.

subcommands.name: modify-workspace-access-properties
subcommands.description: Specifies which devices and operating systems users can use to access their WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: modify-workspace-creation-properties
subcommands.description: Modify the default properties used to create WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: modify-workspace-properties
subcommands.description: Modifies the specified WorkSpace properties.

subcommands.name: modify-workspace-state
subcommands.description: Sets the state of the specified WorkSpace.

subcommands.name: reboot-workspaces
subcommands.description: Reboots the specified WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: rebuild-workspaces
subcommands.description: Rebuilds the specified WorkSpace.

subcommands.name: register-workspace-directory
subcommands.description: Registers the specified directory.

subcommands.name: reject-account-link-invitation
subcommands.description: Rejects the account link invitation.

subcommands.name: restore-workspace
subcommands.description: Restores the specified WorkSpace to its last known healthy state.

subcommands.name: revoke-ip-rules
subcommands.description: Removes one or more rules from the specified IP access control group.

subcommands.name: start-workspaces
subcommands.description: Starts the specified WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: start-workspaces-pool
subcommands.description: Starts the specified pool.

subcommands.name: stop-workspaces
subcommands.description: Stops the specified WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: stop-workspaces-pool
subcommands.description: Stops the specified pool.

subcommands.name: terminate-workspaces
subcommands.description: Terminates the specified WorkSpaces.

subcommands.name: terminate-workspaces-pool
subcommands.description: Terminates the specified pool.

subcommands.name: terminate-workspaces-pool-session
subcommands.description: Terminates the pool session.

subcommands.name: update-connect-client-add-in
subcommands.description: Updates a Connect Customer client add-in.

subcommands.name: update-connection-alias-permission
subcommands.description: Shares or unshares a connection alias with one account by specifying whether that account has permission to associate the connection alias with a directory.

subcommands.name: update-rules-of-ip-group
subcommands.description: Replaces the current rules of the specified IP access control group with the specified rules.

subcommands.name: update-workspace-bundle
subcommands.description: Updates a WorkSpace bundle with a new image.

subcommands.name: update-workspace-image-permission
subcommands.description: Shares or unshares an image with one account in the same Amazon Web Services Region by specifying whether that account has permission to copy the image.

subcommands.name: update-workspaces-pool
subcommands.description: Updates the specified pool.
